assumptions: GEOID S1GRD tiles are linear sigma0 at 10 m with about 4.4 equivalent looks.
The CEMS-derived label was drawn from the same Sentinel-1 pass as the post-event input.
Mapped background is not confirmed dry land.
Permanent water in the label is modelled; it is a non-flood class in the primary comparison and left out of the secondary one.
No DEM, slope, HAND or land-cover layer for these tiles is on disk, so neither method uses one.
Pre-event and post-event passes are almost four months apart and come from different orbit directions.
confidence: low: a research benchmark on one foreign event with a spatial split by tile; every score is agreement with a same-pass CEMS map, not independent accuracy
disclosures: One foreign event. The split is spatial, by tile.
The earlier all-tile diagnostic on this branch saw the test tiles.
Whether any M1-v2 tuning existed before this run is unknown to the agent (the owners answered 'not sure' when they signed v1a). This run is the first tuning recorded in the repository.
required_statement: v2 thresholds were tuned on GEOID development tiles and scored on held-out GEOID test tiles against a same-pass CEMS map (agreement, not independent accuracy). Design choices were informed by the Mae Sai diagnosis. Test tiles had been included in an earlier exploratory all-tile diagnostic (0.161 to 0.455), which is labelled exploratory.

t2_skill_bar.m1_literal: declared unable to meet the bar by protocol v1a, whatever it scores
t2_skill_bar.meaning: One of four conditions, on one foreign event. Not a validation.
not_assessed_here: Mae Sai unit coverage at least 0.80
t2_skill_bar.reading: Both readings (covered and strict) must reach the minimum.

wording: agreement with a same-pass CEMS map, not independent accuracy
